research_notes.finding: Existing useMediaQuery.ts provides basic breakpoint detection. useResponsive.ts should ideally wrap this to provide semantic layout states (desktop, tablet, mobile) consistent with IDELayout requirements.

architecture_patterns.pattern: Mobile: Bottom Tabs, Single View. Tablet: Collapsible Sidebar. Desktop: 3-Panel Resizable.

technical_notes.note: Avoid Hydration Mismatch: Initialize with false or use a documented isomorphic pattern.
react-resizable-panels has built-in persistence, but we requirements specify Zustand middleware for centralized control.
